# Capture of record (local, macOS arm64, 2026-08-01): full committed corpus
# (fuzz/corpus/contriba_diff) replayed under cargo fuzz coverage; lcov
# banked here (contriba_diff.lcov.gz). Local campaign volume: 23.8M execs
# across two rounds (8.34M + 7.81M libFuzzer + 7.69M replay/ASAN leg), all
# under AddressSanitizer (cargo-fuzz default), 0 divergences, 0 panics, 0
# sanitizer reports. Fleet 10M CONFIRM = coordinator follow-up.
# Injection sweep AT CREATION (gate item): 7 planted defects across the
# value plane (soundex table, metaphone B-arm, isn checkdig, dmetaphone
# truncate, daitch start-node soundex, levenshtein sub cost) and the
# sqlstate plane (isn eaninvalid 22P02 -> 22003); 7/7 killed. Three needed
# stronger seeds (interior-vowel soundex word, a 4-phoneme dmetaphone word,
# a 1-letter daitch word) — those seeds are committed.
# SHARED-TEST-BINARY ISOLATION (found + fixed 2026-08-01): the isn.weak fc
# plane needs a bootstrapped GUC store, whose seams (guc_tables/elog/guc)
# sibling lanes install UNGUARDED inside their own Once. Installing them from
# this driver poisoned datetime_io_diff::init_env's Once and failed eleven
# datetime tests. The bootstrap is now gated to cfg!(fuzzing) — the dedicated
# contriba_diff binary, which is exactly the binary this coverage capture
# replays, so the plane stays fully measured (builtins.rs residual = 1 line).
# The standalone witness test is `guc_env_works` (#[ignore]d for the same
# reason; run with `-- --ignored`).
# Soft-error plane witness (gate item): the C oracle's ereturn shim bumps
# pg_ca_soft_fired, and arm 5 asserts the counter fired exactly when the
# Rust side saved a soft error — the plane can never compare Rust to Rust.
# equation per crate: v2_sloc = fuzz_measured + a0 + exception_rows, 0 unaccounted.
